sentences.text: The petitioner was the managing Director at the relevant point in time of Assam Seeds Corporation from 18.03.2019 till 30.06.2020.
The petitioner has superannuated on 30.06.2020 from his office.
During his tenure, certain anomalies were noticed regarding supply of 1000 quintals of pea seeds to Assam Seeds Corporation and against which huge amount of money had been released to the supplier.

Pursuant thereto, it was detected that the seed analysis report submitted by the supplier was found to be forged and the signature of the Seeds Analyst and Seeds Testing Officer found on the Seed Analysis Report were suspected to be not genuine.

The petitioner being the Managing Director after obtaining views from the Director, Assam State Seeds Certification Agency authorized the Assistant Branch Manager, Head Office, Assam Seeds Corporation to file necessary application before the investigation authority.

Accordingly, by communication dated 17.05.2019, the informant namely, Assistant Branch Manager, Head Office, Assam Seed Corporation Ltd. intimated the Office of the Addl. DGP/CID, Ulubari Guwahati regarding the fraud committed by the supplier of the seeds.

Pursuant thereto, the CID authorities initiated the investigation and registered as CID P.S No. 17/2019 under Section 120B/420 /468/471/ 406 / 409 of the IPC.
4.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that although it was the petitioner in his capacity as the MD of Assam Seeds Corporation who had instructed the informant to file necessary complaint before the investigating authority, the petitioner has now learnt that he is also named as one of the Page No.# 3/4 accused persons in the FIR which was registered by the CID Authorities.
Apprehending arrest in connection with the said case, the present application has been filed.
5. The learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam submits that the case diary be called for at this State.
6. Accordingly, let the case diary be called for.
